common-source-radar.note: The inherited article contained unsupported claims about repetition and judgment, fabricated training outcomes, rigid timing targets and high-stakes examples. The effective public record is narrowed to tracing repeated claims back to their underlying documents, datasets or organizations so duplicated summaries are not mistaken for independent support.

confidence-calibration-habit.note: The inherited article contained fabricated calibration statistics, unsupported effect claims, arbitrary percentage increments and decision thresholds, fixed reminder schedules and invented first-party examples. The effective public record is a qualitative judgment log that makes support, uncertainty and update conditions explicit without manufacturing numerical precision.

confirmation-bias-challenge.note: The inherited article contained unsupported historical and cognitive claims, fabricated cohort and volunteer outcomes, fixed habit prescriptions, emotional mechanisms and high-stakes examples. The effective public record is narrowed to one disconfirming check before an ordinary consequential commitment: state the assumption, define an observation that would weaken it, check, then update or escalate.

conjunction-fallacy-coach.note: The inherited article contained fabricated pause experiments, unsupported cognitive mechanisms, arbitrary probability-training bins and daily quotas, plus inappropriate high-stakes examples. The effective public record retains only the logical subset check between A and A-and-B and removes claims about psychological effects or optimal training.

common-source-radar.reason: The effective protocol verifies whether apparently separate claims trace back to independent or shared underlying material. Critical Thinking captures independence checking; Information Management captures source lineage and deduplication.

confidence-calibration-habit.reason: The effective protocol records confidence, support, unknowns and explicit update conditions, then compares the judgment with later outcomes. Metacognition captures monitoring one's own certainty; Decision Making captures how the update affects commitment.

confirmation-bias-challenge.reason: The effective protocol turns a favored assumption into a falsifiable pre-commitment check before an ordinary decision. Critical Thinking captures the disconfirming test; Decision Making captures the resulting update or escalation.

conjunction-fallacy-coach.reason: The effective protocol inspects the logical relationship between a condition and the same condition plus an additional requirement. Critical Thinking captures decomposition; Data Literacy captures correct interpretation of nested event sets.
